purpose: Fail-safe dual-path tactile transmit: PVDF direct to MCU ADC plus CDC array frame, latched slip interrupt plus SPI message to hand; fixed finger vs fingertip board vs hand controller
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))
ax.set_xlim(0, 10); ax.set_ylim(0, 6); ax.axis('off')
ax.text(5, 5.6, 'fail-safe dual-path transmit', ha='center', fontsize=12)
# fingertip board
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.5, 1.2), 4.2, 3.2, fill=False, lw=1.5))
ax.text(2.6, 4.1, 'fingertip PCB (fixed to finger)', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.text(1.2, 3.4, 'PVDF ->', fontsize=9); ax.text(1.2, 2.9, 'MCU ADC', fontsize=9)
ax.text(1.2, 2.3, 'array ->', fontsize=9); ax.text(1.2, 1.8, 'CDC frame', fontsize=9)
# hand controller
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((6.3, 1.2), 3.2, 3.2, fill=False, lw=1.5))
ax.text(7.9, 4.1, 'hand controller', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.text(6.9, 3.0, 'grip loop', fontsize=9)
# two paths
ax.annotate('', xy=(6.3, 3.3), xytext=(4.7, 3.3), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=1.5))
ax.text(5.5, 3.55, 'slip interrupt (fast 1-bit)', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax.annotate('', xy=(6.3, 2.0), xytext=(4.7, 2.0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=1.5))
ax.text(5.5, 2.25, 'SPI frame 100Hz + OK bit', ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax.text(5.5, 0.7, 'break anywhere -> OK lost -> tighten grip', ha='center', fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=120); plt.close()
